clues.it: Carla era nella 1ª riga, accanto a una grata e a ovest di Paolo.
clues.en: Carla was in the 1st row, beside a floor grate and west of Paolo.

clues.it: Vito era accanto a un droide, a nord di Irene e in Laboratorio.
clues.en: Vito was beside a droid, north of Irene and in the Lab.

clues.it: Luca era nella 3ª riga e in Laboratorio, ma non era accanto a una consolle.
clues.en: Luca was in the 3rd row and in the Lab, but was not beside a console.

clues.it: Paolo era accanto a un reattore e a nord di Anna.
clues.en: Paolo was beside a reactor and north of Anna.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a una poltrona, a nord di Marta e in Serra.
clues.en: Irene was beside a flight seat, north of Marta and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Marta era nella stessa stanza di Anna.
clues.en: Marta was in the same room as Anna.

clues.it: Dario era nella 8ª riga, accanto a un'antenna e in Serra.
clues.en: Dario was in the 8th row, beside an antenna and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Olga era nella 7ª colonna, nella 9ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Dario.
clues.en: Olga was in the 7th column, in the 9th row and in the same room as Dario.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a una poltrona ed esattamente una riga a nord di Tea.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a flight seat and exactly one row north of Tea.

clues.it: Tea era nella 11ª riga e da sola nel Criosonno, ma non era accanto a una poltrona.
clues.en: Tea was in the 11th row and alone in the Cryo Bay, but was not beside a flight seat.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: Solo Carla può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 6ª è sua.
steps.en: Carla is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 6th is theirs.

steps.en: Vito is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 9th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 8ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 5th.
